items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Big Sid took me to the Renaissance and set up his drums. He set up his drums with the whole repertoire, Louis' whole repertoire, and we went through the whole repertoire... Sid took me through everything.

ctx.x: Said, "What is that little drummer up there doing?" So Big Sid said, "Man, that little cat is modern, if you listen to him." So that was the biggest sendoff. That was the stamp I needed.
